title: Utsang
tagline: A zonal student congress series for regional collaboration.
short_description: A zonal congress series designed to connect student branches, volunteers, faculty coordinators, and IEEE leaders across regional hubs.
long_description: Utsang creates a shared platform for student branches to collaborate, learn from IEEE leaders, participate in themed sessions, and build stronger regional student networks. Each edition can focus on a different zone, venue, and technical theme while staying under the same flagship identity.
